method: Static read of every backend app's view/serializer/service query surfaces, shared pagination and permission helpers; no environment, database, or test execution was accessed.

configured_engine.value: DB_ENGINE (default django.db.backends.sqlite3); production rejects SQLite and requires DB_* values

runtime_evidence.value: Archived isolated gate observed MySQL 8.4.10, utf8mb4/utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci, REPEATABLE-READ; this is historical evidence, not a live connection check.

findings.impact: All three paged workflow collections: approvals, exceptions, collaboration. A page of N rows adds N audit-event queries and serializes every audit event for each row.
findings.permission_invariant: Keep tenant and permission-specific scope filtering in visible_approvals/visible_exceptions/visible_collaboration; events must remain restricted to the serialized parent tenant and resource_type/resource_id.
findings.minimal_fix: For collection endpoints, bulk-fetch WorkflowAuditEvent for the page's parent IDs keyed by (resource_type, resource_id), pass that map in serializer context, and retain the current filtered fallback only for detail/direct serializer use. Alternatively omit audit_events from collection DTOs and expose it only on detail routes.
findings.test: Add CaptureQueriesContext coverage for 2 and 20 rows for each collection, asserting a bounded count independent of page length plus no cross-tenant event leakage. Existing pagination contracts are backend/apps/workflows/views.py:39-157; no workflow query-budget test was found.

findings.impact: Store and SKU sales report endpoints aggregate potentially all scoped groups into Python dictionaries/lists, sort/filter in Python, then paginate. The overview also emits only the first 50 store rows but computes every group and several repeated aggregate query sets.
findings.permission_invariant: Every aggregate must retain _scoped_orders/_scoped_refunds and their store/platform/region/date scope predicates; currencies must remain separate and refund status semantics must not change.
findings.minimal_fix: Move supported ordering and page slicing to grouped database querysets (or introduce a materialized report snapshot for cross-fact merges). Request summary/trend only when requested; reuse a per-request computed summary instead of recomputing _currency_summary/_sales_quality in each page payload.
findings.test: Seed more groups than page_size under two tenants and restricted stores; compare current versus rewritten page results/currency totals, assert no unscoped group appears, and establish query/time budgets. Existing functional pagination coverage: backend/tests/test_sales_reports.py and backend/tests/test_sales_order_sorting.py.
findings.current_action: Keep complete authorized cross-fact/currency summary and trend semantics. SQL merge/pagination redesign needs a separate paired metric acceptance; this candidate does not cap groups or alter metrics.

findings.impact: Lookup returns all matching current variants. SkuPriceSnapshot has unique (tenant,listing,external_sku,variant_id), so the prior claim of unbounded historical snapshots was incorrect.
findings.permission_invariant: Keep require_all_scope(influencers.catalog.view), tenant, store, and site predicates; do not return prices from another store/site merely to fill a page.
findings.minimal_fix: Define deterministic latest-per-(external_sku, variant_id) semantics or add validated page/page_size with a capped default and stable ordering. If historical rows are required, make that explicit with bounded pagination.
findings.test: Create >100 matching snapshots and assert cap/page stability, tenant/store/site isolation, and expected latest-row behavior.
findings.current_action: Preserve complete variant lookup contract; do not silently cap or redefine latest semantics.

findings.impact: Active product-cost warehouse option endpoint returns every active warehouse without pagination or an explicit cap; this grows with tenant master data and is called as a selection source.
findings.permission_invariant: Retain IsProductCostViewer and tenant/status predicates; the cost-create warehouse validation must remain tenant-scoped (backend/apps/products/cost_views.py:113-121).
findings.minimal_fix: Add a bounded search/limit (and stable code ordering), or document and enforce a tenant-level upper bound for active warehouse choices. Use values() to avoid model construction if full option metadata stays required.
findings.test: Create >cap active warehouses plus another tenant's warehouse; assert stable cap/search and no cross-tenant values.
findings.current_action: Read only id/code/name/country_code through values(), preserve all authorized active options and existing order; no arbitrary option truncation.

verified_existing_controls.control: Shared ORM pagination performs COUNT plus page slice rather than list materialization when callers provide QuerySets.
Config change-log list uses correlated Subquery annotation to avoid its serializer fallback lookup per row.
System user list supplies related/prefetched data and serializer consumes cached role links, explicitly avoiding its prior N+1 path.
Product SPU collection paginates and uses select_related/prefetch_related before serialization.

suggested_commands: cd backend; pytest tests/test_sc_supply_flow_api_2.py tests/test_sales_reports.py tests/test_sales_order_sorting.py -q
test_resources.not_run: Read-only audit did not run tests or connect to MySQL.

open_questions: No live database connection was authorized, so production row counts, EXPLAIN plans, and actual MySQL version remain unverified for the current environment.
Sales report response contracts need a product decision on whether every aggregate group/trend is required on each paged request before moving grouping/pagination fully into SQL.
recommended_action: Assign BE-R1 and BE-R2 first; they have bounded API surfaces, preserveable authorization rules, and clear query-budget acceptance tests.

excluded_findings.impact: Internal consolidation, site, shipment and supplier-assignment lists materialize the authorized result before page slicing. Consolidation additionally prefetched allocations for every matching aggregation, so large tenants consume memory and query related rows outside the requested page.
excluded_findings.permission_invariant: Preserve require_internal/require_supplier, tenant filters, and exact DataScope matching. Do not convert an unauthorized object into an empty visible row; current detail semantics intentionally return not-found.
excluded_findings.minimal_fix: Translate ALL/CUSTOM scope IDs and request filters into queryset predicates before Paginator; paginate the queryset first, then select_related/prefetch only page records. For complex consolidation dimension scope that cannot be represented safely in SQL, retain Python authorization but introduce a bounded cursor/window contract rather than list(items).
excluded_findings.test: Create more than one page of in-scope and out-of-scope sites/consolidations/allocations. Assert response/count/order/404 semantics match, only page records' allocations are loaded, and query count plus fetched object count do not grow with total records. Reuse API fixtures in backend/tests/test_sc_supply_flow_api_2.py and backend/tests/test_sc_consolidation_1_local.py.
excluded_findings.current_action: none while supply_chain module remains disabled

excluded_findings.impact: Supplier assignment collection adds two queries per returned allocation (release event and accepted attachments) after already materializing the entire filtered collection. Page size 100 therefore has an N+1 tail even after pagination is corrected.
excluded_findings.permission_invariant: Accepted evidence must remain constrained by tenant, consolidation_handover, allocation business_id, current release version, supplier owner_type/owner_id, and ACCEPTED state; supplier DTO remains limited to ID/state.
excluded_findings.minimal_fix: After page selection, bulk-fetch release events by consolidation_id and accepted ControlledAttachment rows by allocation/supplier/release-version, build context maps, and make supplier_assignment_dto consume the maps. Avoid broad attachment prefetch that exposes hashes or business binding fields.
excluded_findings.test: Add query-budget tests for 1/20 supplier allocations spanning multiple consolidations; assert only the owning supplier sees accepted evidence and changing release version invalidates prior evidence.
excluded_findings.current_action: none while supply_chain module remains disabled

audit_scope: Static source mapping only; current Aliyun module switches apply. No runtime/database/cloud validation was performed. Findings under disabled modules are retained as excluded with no current action.

additional_verified_fixes.description: Current page latest snapshots/connectivity/scoped API metadata loaded in batches; 20-row synthetic page 295 to29 queries; response bytes/hash identical.
Request-local permission resolution cache shared across views/widgets; revoked scope checked anew on next request.
